responsibility: Defines the Rust AST and parsing support for macros and attribute meta-items. It covers fragment specifiers (`MacroFragSpec`), matcher node classes for `macro_rules!` patterns and repetitions, rule/transcriber and invocation structures, builtin/meta-item AST forms (`MetaWord`, `MetaNameValueStr`, `MetaListPaths`, `MetaListNameValueStr`, `MetaItemSeq`), and the `AttributeParser` that parses token streams into meta-item syntax, making this the module’s main representation and lightweight parsing layer for Rust macro and attribute syntax.
same_name_distinction: Defines the main macro and attribute AST surface for this module—fragment specifiers, matcher/repetition/invocation structures, meta-item classes, and `AttributeParser`. Unlike rust-macro.cc, which only implements builtin macro name classification, this header is the broad declaration layer for macro syntax representation and lightweight parsing support.
